title: CAFE-AQI: Coverage-Aware Day-Ahead AQI Forecasting with Early Warning and Conformal Uncertainty in Bangladesh
abstract: arXiv:2611.23815v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Next-day air quality forecasting often assumes city records are equally complete and independent. However, an audit of a large Bangladesh dataset revealed a sharp coverage expansion after August 2022 and showed that 103 city labels correspond to only 61 unique AQI trajectories. To address these issues, this paper presents CAFE-AQI, a coverage-aware framework for forecasting next-day maximum AQI. It also estimates the probability of Unhealthy-or-worse conditions (AQI >= 151). Data were divided chronologically into training (2022-2023), calibration (2024), and testing (2025). To prevent duplicate records from dominating training and evaluation, identical trajectories were weighted. The framework combines temporal and pollutant features with a five-neighbor spatial context. translated_title: CAFE-AQI：孟加拉国覆盖感知的次日AQI预测——融合早期预警与共形不确定性量化
translated_abstract: 次日空气质量预测通常假设各城市的记录同等完整且相互独立。然而，对一个大型的孟加拉国数据集进行审计后发现，2022年8月之后数据覆盖范围出现急剧扩张，且103个城市标签实际上仅对应61条独特的AQI轨迹。为解决这些问题，本文提出了CAFE-AQI，一个覆盖感知的次日最大AQI预测框架，同时估计空气质量达到“不健康或更差”级别（AQI ≥ 151）的概率。数据按时间顺序划分为训练集（2022-2023年）、校准集（2024年）和测试集（2025年）。为防止重复记录主导训练与评估过程，框架对相同轨迹进行了加权处理。该框架将时间与污染物特征同五个邻近站点的空间上下文相结合，并包含一个类别均衡的预警头和基于风险条件的共形校准，旨在提供早期预警和预测区间。
tldr: 该论文提出CAFE-AQI框架，通过审计发现孟加拉国数据集中城市标签重复与覆盖突变问题并加以加权处理，结合时空特征、类别均衡预警头和风险条件共形校准，实现次日最大AQI预测、健康风险早期预警及不确定性区间估计。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes CAFE-AQI, a coverage-aware framework for day-ahead AQI forecasting in Bangladesh that identifies and handles duplicate city trajectories and coverage shifts through trajectory weighting, combining spatiotemporal features, a class-balanced warning head, and risk-conditional conformal calibration to deliver early warnings and prediction intervals.
